blocks.text: Zscaler recommends reviewing your Chrome posture profiles periodically to ensure security evaluation is required for your devices using the Chrome Enterprise browser.
To edit a Chrome posture profile:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Chrome Enterprise Browser > Chrome Posture Profile.
Locate the posture profile that you want to modify, and click the Edit icon.
In the Edit Chrome Posture Profile drawer, modify the fields as necessary. To learn more, see Configuring Chrome Posture Profiles.

blocks.text: To delete a Chrome posture profile:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Browser > Chrome Enterprise Browser > Chrome Posture Profile.
Locate the posture profile that you want to delete, and click the Delete icon.
Click Delete to confirm the deletion of the selected Chrome posture profile.
